06/10.01.2025 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Koderma P.S. Case No. 25/2023, registered for the offence under sections 406, 420/34 of the of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned C.J.M., Koderma.

Vide order dated 26.11.2024 at the request of the parties, the matter was referred to secretary DLSA,
Koderma for initiating mediation proceedings between the parties.
Report regarding the mediation has been received and it appears that the parties have settled their dispute.
Learned lawyer for both the parties are present and have submitted that the parties have settled the dispute.
The offence alleged is under sections 406/ 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case and considering the fact that the parties have settled the dispute, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing Deepmala Kumari vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
